standard: Web gateway access log (transparent filtering; encrypted sites are logged as CONNECT with no path)
cadence: per request; a sample (about 1 in 40 of the requests of people at their desks or on the VPN, and of machines' own traffic)
notes: One folder per organisation: city, nascc, brw, port, srmc, bcmc, county. Each organisation has its own products, rule names, zone names and habits; do not assume a value seen in one folder means the same in another. Hosts, addresses and accounts are in 06_data_streams/partner_it_registry.json.

fields.name: client_ip
fields.notes: registry host ip or VPN pool address

fields.name: user
fields.notes: registry account of the person logged on at the client, or - when the machine itself made the request

fields.name: method
fields.notes: CONNECT for encrypted sites (no path is visible); GET, POST or HEAD otherwise

fields.name: host
fields.notes: name requested; outside names are invented

fields.name: status
fields.notes: HTTP status the gateway returned or relayed: 200, 204, 301, 302, 304, 403 (blocked by policy), 404, 500, 502, 503, 504

fields.name: bytes_out
fields.notes: payload bytes sent by the client

fields.name: user_agent_family
fields.notes: browser family and platform; - for machine traffic
